evidence.title: KokonutUI - Free Open Source UI Components for React and Tailwind CSS

name: KokonutUI
summary: Free open-source library of 100+ animated React and Tailwind CSS components, installable from a shadcn registry.
description: Open-source UI components for React and Next.js built with Tailwind CSS and Motion: backgrounds, cards, navigation, inputs, AI chat pieces, text effects, buttons and micro-interactions. Each component has a live preview and a Markdown source page with its full code and a shadcn CLI install command under the @kokonutui namespace; the collection also works through the shadcn MCP server so coding agents can browse and install it. A paid Kokonut UI Pro offers a further component set.
contains: 100+ free open-source components with live previews
sections: templates, backgrounds, cards, navigation, inputs, AI, texts, buttons
installs with the shadcn CLI via the @kokonutui namespace or registry URL
component pages link Markdown source with install command and full code
shadcn MCP server support for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex
7 templates: Agenta, Lume, Sonae, AI, Futur, Postly, Startup
paid Kokonut UI Pro with 100+ additional components
